docs.summary: Abstract base class for every retained-mode UI component.
docs.remarks: UI components do not draw themselves. Instead, the owning [`GameCanvas`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.GameCanvas) traverses the hierarchy in depth-first order and calls [`GenerateMesh`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.UIBehaviour~GenerateMesh) on each [`UIBehaviour`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.UIBehaviour) whose mesh is dirty, then bakes the result into `CachedMesh` for the pipeline to consume.

docs.summary: Stamp of external state the baked mesh depends on but which nothing dirties: text geometry is tied to the glyph atlas, and the atlas is rewritten (and its UVs rescaled) as new glyphs arrive. The canvas re-bakes whenever this moves, so it holds in edit mode too, where `Update` does not run.
Called when the object becomes enabled and active. Only called when the GameObject is in a Scene and enabled.
Called when the object becomes disabled or inactive. Only called when the GameObject was in a Scene and becomes disabled.
Called when the GameObject is added to a Scene. This happens before OnEnable and only once per scene add.
Called when the GameObject is removed from a Scene. This happens after OnDisable and only once per scene remove.

members.name: GenerateMesh
members.signature: public abstract void GenerateMesh(UIMeshBuilder builder, in UIContext context)

docs.summary: Subclasses fill `builder` in canvas-local pixel space.

True while this element's geometry is built from an asset that hasn't streamed in yet, so what it baked is missing or a placeholder.

The canvas stays dirty while any element reports this. Nothing else would bring it back: a clean canvas skips the whole rebuild walk, so an element that baked nothing on frame one is never asked again, and the asset arriving changes nothing on screen until something unrelated (a window resize) happens to dirty the canvas.
The texture this element draws with as the material's _MainTex, or null to keep the material's own.
The material this element draws with. Default returns the shared `DefaultUI` material.

members.name: SetField
members.signature: protected bool SetField<T>(ref T field, T value, UIDirtyFlags flags)

docs.summary: Backing-field setter used by every [`UIBehaviour`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.UIBehaviour) property. Assigns `value` only when it differs from `field`, and marks `flags` dirty when it does. Returns `true` if the value changed - callers can branch on it for additional work (see `CanvasGroup.Alpha`).
docs.remarks: This is the single place the UI's value-change check lives. `Default` resolves correctly for every property type in use: structs (`Color`, `Float2`) compare by value, and [`EngineObject`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.EngineObject) references (`Texture2D`, `Material`, `FontAsset`) compare by reference via [`EngineObject`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.EngineObject)'s overridden equality.
